run_world_visualizer: run the Minecraft-style 3D world visualizer with pyglet OpenGL rendering and WASD controls
create_model_add_block: create a Model instance and add a textured block at a given 3D position in the world
create_model_remove_block: create a Model instance and remove a block at a given 3D position from the world
test_model_hit_test: test the Model hit_test method to find blocks in the player line of sight
review_window_class: review the Window class for Minecraft-style camera controls, collision detection, and block rendering
